title: Part sale Customer card shows Bill To reading This customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new part sale for this test, part sale 1, for customer A, open, that bills itself.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part sale 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R1: “The card's expanded section shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer.”
  • S3-R2: “The field reads "This customer" when the customer pays for itself, otherwise the Bill To's name.”
  • Feature Overview, Release day: “Users who can change a work order's customer see a "Bill To" field reading "This customer" on every work order and part sale Customer card (Story 3).”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “Every work order, part sale and invoice has two customers: the customer (the work is for them) and the Bill To (they owe the invoice). The Bill To starts as the customer itself.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
